paragraphs: Yishmael of Kefar Yama; some say, of Kefar Dima.

Mentioned in [Nedarim 57b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.57b.2-3): he brought a question before Rabbi Ami, who had no answer. He came before Rabbi Yitzchak Nappacha, who resolved it for him.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman adds “a question” in parentheses. The fuller Gemara describes an onion as the object Yishmael brought forward.

The linked Nedarim spells the alternative place name Dyama and describes the question as concerning an onion uprooted in the sabbatical year and replanted the following year. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2275&lang=en) summarizes the same exchange. Hyman gives the question in abbreviated form.
